name: Tell Me About Yourself
description: The AI interviewer asks the candidate to introduce themselves, outline their career journey, and highlight key strengths.
conversation_goal: Deliver a concise, engaging 2-minute elevator pitch connecting past experience to future career aspirations.
objective: Deliver a concise, engaging 2-minute elevator pitch connecting past experience to future career aspirations.
forbidden_topics: Overly personal non-professional details
Negative comments about previous employers
opening_message: Welcome! Thank you for taking the time to speak with us today. To get started, could you tell me a little bit about yourself and your background?

name: Overcoming Workplace Adversity
description: Demonstrate conflict resolution, resilience, and adaptability using the STAR method.
conversation_goal: Articulate a specific challenge at work, actions taken, and measurable outcomes.
objective: Articulate a specific challenge at work, actions taken, and measurable outcomes.
forbidden_topics: Blaming colleagues without taking personal ownership
Vague hypothetical scenarios without concrete past examples
opening_message: Can you describe a time when you faced a significant hurdle or disagreement at work, and how you worked through it?

name: Python Problem Solving
description: The interviewer evaluates how the candidate explains their approach to algorithmic problem-solving and clean Python code design.
conversation_goal: Explain thought process, time/space complexity trade-offs, and edge case handling clearly.
objective: Explain thought process, time/space complexity trade-offs, and edge case handling clearly.
forbidden_topics: Writing brute force code without analyzing complexity
Ignoring memory constraints and stream edge cases
opening_message: Let's work through a problem. Suppose you need to process a continuous stream of numerical transactions and find the rolling top-K elements in real-time. How would you design this?

name: Distributed Cache Architecture
description: Discuss high-availability system architecture, cache invalidation strategies, and latency trade-offs.
conversation_goal: Design a scalable distributed caching layer handling millions of requests per second.
objective: Design a scalable distributed caching layer handling millions of requests per second.
forbidden_topics: Assuming zero network latency or 100% network reliability
Neglecting cache stampede and thundering herd mitigation
opening_message: Let's design a distributed in-memory cache system for a global e-commerce platform. What are your key architectural components and consistency guarantees?

name: AI Solution Pitch
description: The candidate presents an enterprise AI automation solution to an executive decision-maker.
conversation_goal: Communicate business value, ROI, deployment safety, and competitive differentiation.
objective: Communicate business value, ROI, deployment safety, and competitive differentiation.
forbidden_topics: Buzzword overload without technical depth
Overpromising 100% accuracy on non-deterministic AI models
opening_message: Thanks for joining our executive briefing. We are considering modernizing our customer workflows. What makes your AI solution the right fit for our enterprise?

name: Seed Round Investor Pitch
description: Pitch a high-growth tech startup to angel and seed-stage venture capital investors.
conversation_goal: Articulate market size, defensible moat, unit economics, and growth metrics convincingly.
objective: Articulate market size, defensible moat, unit economics, and growth metrics convincingly.
forbidden_topics: Unrealistic hockey-stick projections without CAC/LTV validation
Dismissing existing market incumbents
opening_message: We have reviewed your deck briefly. Give us your 3-minute pitch on why this is a venture-scale opportunity and why your team will win.

name: Executive Product Briefing
description: Present high-level business software benefits to executive leadership in clear, jargon-free language.
conversation_goal: Explain strategic revenue impact and user adoption in simple, compelling terms.
objective: Explain strategic revenue impact and user adoption in simple, compelling terms.
forbidden_topics: Deep technical jargon and esoteric framework names
Overly granular code architecture details
opening_message: I only have a few minutes between meetings. In plain English, how will your product help our business grow this quarter?

name: Project Architecture Explanation
description: The candidate explains the architecture, design choices, and technical decisions behind a completed project.
conversation_goal: Defend technology stack choices, database schema design, and modularity principles.
objective: Defend technology stack choices, database schema design, and modularity principles.
forbidden_topics: Saying 'I picked it because it was popular' without engineering rationale
Concealing known system bugs or design limitations
opening_message: Please present the high-level architecture of your capstone project and explain why you chose this specific tech stack over alternatives.

name: Methodology & Validation Defense
description: Defend experimental methodology, dataset selection, evaluation metrics, and error analysis in academic research.
conversation_goal: Critically analyze validation rigor, baseline comparisons, and generalizability of results.
objective: Critically analyze validation rigor, baseline comparisons, and generalizability of results.
forbidden_topics: Claiming results are flawless without error analysis
Evaluating models solely on train datasets
opening_message: Let's look at your evaluation methodology. How did you ensure baseline comparability, and what steps were taken to prevent dataset leakage?

name: AI in the Workplace
description: The candidate participates in a structured discussion about the ethical and productivity impacts of AI on workplaces.
conversation_goal: Contribute balanced viewpoints, listen actively, and build constructively on others' arguments.
objective: Contribute balanced viewpoints, listen actively, and build constructively on others' arguments.
forbidden_topics: Interrupting aggressively or talking over other participants
Taking extreme dogmatic stances without acknowledging counterpoints
opening_message: The topic for today's discussion is 'Artificial Intelligence in the Modern Workplace: Threat or Opportunity?'. Who would like to open the discussion?

name: Future of Remote vs Hybrid Culture
description: Engage in a collaborative debate on workplace autonomy, team cohesion, and async communication norms.
conversation_goal: Present clear, data-informed arguments while facilitating group consensus.
objective: Present clear, data-informed arguments while facilitating group consensus.
forbidden_topics: Using anecdotal evidence as universal truth
Ignoring employee mental health and burnout nuances
opening_message: Welcome everyone. Today we are debating whether fully remote work models hinder innovation compared to hybrid setups. Please share your perspective.

name: Handling a Difficult Team Situation
description: The candidate explains how they would handle a challenging team situation involving mismatched expectations and tight deadlines.
conversation_goal: Demonstrate empathetic leadership, accountability, conflict mediation, and decisive action under pressure.
objective: Demonstrate empathetic leadership, accountability, conflict mediation, and decisive action under pressure.
forbidden_topics: Publicly shaming underperforming employees
Hiding bad news from leadership stakeholders
opening_message: Imagine two senior engineers on your team strongly disagree on an architectural decision, causing a two-week sprint delay. How would you step in and resolve this?

name: Managing Competing Executive Priorities
description: Navigate conflicting roadmap requests from Product, Sales, and Engineering with transparent trade-offs.
conversation_goal: Demonstrate prioritization frameworks, transparent expectation-setting, and diplomatic negotiation.
objective: Demonstrate prioritization frameworks, transparent expectation-setting, and diplomatic negotiation.
forbidden_topics: Saying 'yes' to all stakeholders resulting in team overcommitment and failure
Making arbitrary decisions without data or framework
opening_message: Sales has committed a custom feature to close a major deal, while Engineering needs the sprint to remediate critical tech debt. How do you handle this priority clash?
